title: Harmful design in virtual worlds
description: An NSF-funded collaboration studies harmful design practices in user-generated virtual worlds and approaches to design moderation.

funding.program: SaTC: CORE: Small: Investigating and Mitigating Harmful Design in User-Generated Virtual World through Design Moderation

label: Games / Design
longDescription: User-generated virtual worlds such as Roblox let players, many of them children, both play games and build them. This NSF-funded project studies how harmful design emerges in these worlds, from predatory monetization and gambling-like mechanics to designs that expose young players to safety risks, and how design moderation by platforms and creators can mitigate it.
The project combines studies of players, children, and game creators, including co-design sessions with children, to inform safer design practices and platform governance.
leadership: PI: Yubo Kou. Co-PIs: Xinning Gui and Sunhye Bai.
